completed_missions.title: Build persistent 11-agent Hixton swarm
completed_missions.result: Eleven role contracts, persistent knowledge, regression protocol and GitHub-hosted cloud orchestration were established. Legacy laptop-bound engineering launchers and local agent runners were removed.

completed_missions.title: Complete USDT to USDC migration audit, explain backtest delta, repair defects, retest
completed_missions.result: The complete A01-A11 chain passed after repairs. No supported USDT-to-USDC strategy/code defect explains the historic 733-versus-about-203 difference. The dominant difference is the non-equivalent account path: the old USDT reference carried prior equity/positions into the later period, while the later USDT/USDC controls restarted fresh. On the same fresh-start window USDC slightly outperformed USDT. Persistent portfolio drawdown/risk halting explains most rejected entries on the fresh path. Paper/shared-portfolio parity matched exactly under equivalent assumptions.

active_mission.title: Hixton 0.5.0 max-capital product release
active_mission.objective: Release one coherent V6 system where UI, exact-three-year portfolio backtest, Paper and normal Live all consume the same saved max_capital_usdc and CAPITAL-V1-2X50PCT allocator; preserve isolated 10x250 as coin research and preserve the separate controlled 1x50 Binance round-trip.
active_mission.last_transition_reason: Owner requested complete start-ready bot for the controlled 1x50 Binance test, with UI prepared for 250-USDC max-budget Live and A01-A11 final verification.
constraints: UI exposes one editable capital value only: max_capital_usdc. Slot count, tranche size, reserve and allocation policy are derived and not separate user truths.
CAPITAL-V1-2X50PCT is the current validated allocator for 100..1000 USDC: two ranked_repeat tranches at 50 percent each; default 250 -> 2x125.
Portfolio backtest, Paper and normal Live consume the same saved max_capital_usdc and central capital_plan; any mismatch fails closed.
The first real-money stage remains a separate explicit 1x50 USDC round-trip. Arming it sends no immediate/backfilled order and does not rewrite max_capital_usdc.
Continuous Live requires completed/reconciled 1x50, fresh safe Binance account check, healthy runtime, Paper soak and a persisted capital-plan binding.
Changing max_capital_usdc while a Live ledger is active must stop new entries and may not silently resize an active plan.
10x250 isolated remains coin-optimization research only. Candidate discovery is isolated; portfolio compatibility is checked against the canonical max-budget portfolio.
All ten coin profiles come from one canonical V6 map. Current promoted deltas include XRP CMO 0.15, AVAX band 5.2 and DOT CMO 0.35.
Exact product backtests cover three calendar years backwards from the end time plus 400 warm-up bars and fail closed on insufficient history.
Cloud A01-A11 remain key-free and must not send real or testnet orders or request private Binance credentials.
No historical simulation may be presented as guaranteed future performance or proof of historical Binance fills.
acceptance: A01 proves README/DMS describe max_capital_usdc, CAPITAL-V1-2X50PCT, 10x250 research separation and the separate 1x50 trial without current 3x80 product claims.

A02 produces a fresh exact-three-year dashboard portfolio E2E using default 250-USDC max budget -> 2x125 ranked_repeat and a fresh isolated 10x250 optimization recheck against the same canonical portfolio.
A03 proves Paper/backtest/Live signal and allocator parity, including ranked_repeat and restart persistence.
A04 proves shipped UI has exactly one editable max-capital field, server-derived allocator status, protected local Binance credentials, 1x50 trial and max-budget Live controls.
A05 validates persistent Paper state against the current V6 and 250-USDC default capital plan.
A06 passes the full regression suite and explicit duplicate/retry/timeout/restart/budget-change Live failure matrix.
A07 verifies current public Binance Spot USDC market and MARKET/LOT/notional constraints for all ten symbols without credentials.
A08 verifies default 250 -> 2x125 risk/slot limits and that 10x250 research never becomes a Live sizing source.
A10 accepts evidence only when A01-A08 all satisfy the current max-budget contract.
A09 emits QA_PASS only from fresh evidence on the exact release commit.
A11 emits GOVERNANCE_PASS only after QA_PASS and refuses any claim that an actual Binance round-trip already occurred.
The shipped static UI displays Hixton 0.5.0 and the release commit is identical to the tested/downloadable commit.
